    - heading "The everyday endocrine signs." [level=2]
    - paragraph: Most endocrine skin signs you meet come from common disease. New generalised darkening, strongest in skin creases, scars, mucosa and sun-exposed skin, can signal primary adrenal insufficiency, which can turn into a life-threatening crisis. Hirsutism that appears fast, keeps progressing, or comes with a deepening voice or clitoromegaly makes an androgen-secreting tumour more likely. Velvety dark plaques of acanthosis nigricans track insulin resistance, pretibial myxoedema points to Graves' disease, and cold, dry skin suggests hypothyroidism.
